messages:
IncidentBot: [pager] SEV2 - Traffic-shift not completing during regional failover. Observed: spike in 5xx and timeouts for region eu-central-1 starting ~01:50Z; automated traffic-shift to eu-west-2 partially applied. Pager sent to oncall@sre. Incident ticket: https://incidents.redwood.internal/3623457000
Sam: Picking up. I can see a divergence between routing-control and edge routing table. routing-control reports weight for eu-central-1=0 but edge still sends ~12% of requests.
Priya: Checking routecache logs. Reconcile job failed at 01:51Z with OOM during provider API flakiness. It retried but backup snapshot was stale, so some prefixes retained old assignments.
Rafael: Provider status shows transient AZ networking issue in eu-central-1b at 01:49Z. They reported partial fabric degrade then quick recovery. Might have caused inconsistent BGP state.
Sam: Ok, we need to minimize customer impact. Proposal: 1) force region-level override to drain eu-central-1, 2) add temporary edge rule to re-route requests with header X-Region -> eu-west-2, 3) notify CS.
Priya: Before forcing, I recommend a small canary shift to confirm target region capacity. If eu-west-2 healthy, do 10% then 0.
Sam: Agreed. Run canary and watch 5xx and p50/p95.
Priya: Executing canary at 02:00Z: ```redwoodctl routing set --region eu-central-1 --weight 0 --canary 10 --reason "emergency failover due to AZ net flap"```
IncidentBot: Canary applied. Metrics hook created: /metrics/3623457000/canary
Tara: Canary traffic shows decrease in EU 5xx from 6.2% -> 3.1% within 90s. Some CDNs still hitting eu-central-1.
Rafael: I'll query edge logs for origin IPs and CDN ASNs. If caches are sticky we may need to issue purge or serve a redirect from edge.
Sam: Ok proceed to full override at 02:04Z if canary looks stable. Priya, please run: ```redwoodctl routing apply-override --region eu-central-1 --weight 0 --force```
Priya: Full override applied at 02:04:22Z. routing-control shows eu-central-1 weight=0. Observed global 5xx drop to ~0.9% in 3m.
IncidentBot: Incident update: automated rollback circuits prevented flare due to high p95; manual override in effect.
Tara: Noted residual traffic ~0.8% still reaching eu-central-1; investigating. Could be external DNS TTL or stale CDN POPs with pinned origin pools.
Rafael: Found small set of POPs returning old edge hints. Pushed rewrite rule at edge at 02:08Z: requests with upstream-host header matching eu-central-1 origin now rewritten to eu-west-2. Also initiated CDN soft purge for interactive endpoints.
ops-cs: Customer impact: open tickets from several EU customers reporting failed chats and long waits. Sent initial customer bulletin at 02:09Z and added account leads.
Sam: Good. I'm seeing health checks for eu-central-1 backends failing intermittently; leaving them draining. Let's leave override until provider confirms clear plus 1 hour stabilization.
Priya: Root cause hypothesis: provider's AZ fabric transiently flapped -> routecache reconcile hit OOM during provider API delays -> partial state wrote to edge causing inconsistent prefix weights. Fix planned: add durable WAL checkpoint, limit reconcile memory, and add backoff to reconcile on provider error. Hotfix PR #1498 authored, will patch routecache service tonight.
Rafael: Provider telemetry shows their fabric recovered at 02:12Z. They report BGP session resets with some route propagation delays. We should coordinate with them to validate no lingering ECMP asymmetry.
Sam: Handoff: I'm handing to night oncall at 02:15Z. Summary: manual override in place (eu-central-1 weight 0), edge rewrite and CDN purge executed, CS notified. Open actions: validate provider all-clear, deploy routecache hotfix, monitor residual requests and errors, schedule postmortem.
oncall-night: Taking over. I'll keep the override until 03:30Z and perform a staged roll-back if metrics stable. Watchlist: eu-5xx_rate, p95 latencies, edge residuals.
ops-cs: Sending follow-up customer update at 02:17Z with mitigation steps and ETA for rollback.
Priya: Deployed routecache hotfix canary at 02:22Z (limited to one region controller). No regressions. Planning full rollout in 30m.
IncidentBot: Metric snapshot: eu_central_5xx_rate dropped 6.2%->0.7% between 01:50Z-02:10Z.
Rafael: Provider reports no current alarms at 02:25Z but recommends we keep traffic diverted for 60 more minutes due to possible RIB convergence.
oncall-night: Will keep override until 03:30Z and attempt staged rollback at 03:35Z: 25% -> 50% -> full with 5m observation windows.
Sam: Capture timeline & severity rationale for postmortem. Assign owners: Priya (routecache fix), Rafael (provider validation & peering checks), Tara (CDN purge verification), ops-cs (customer comms).
ops-cs: Confirmed second customer update posted at 02:29Z.
Priya: Full routecache hotfix rolled out at 02:40Z; WAL enabled and reconcile memory cap applied. No new reconcile failures observed.
IncidentBot: Incident status -> mitigated at 02:44Z. Next scheduled update at 03:35Z or sooner on changes.
oncall-night: I'm monitoring. If rollback proceeds cleanly I'll coordinate revert of edge rewrite and CDN cache revalidation.
Sam: Thanks all. We'll schedule a postmortem and customer RCA. Closing active mitigation from my side.
